FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key

WITH f AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) fact_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) fact_nonstaff, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(receipts) rrc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(f.store_id,r.store_id) id, fact_net, fact_nonstaff, rpt_gross, rpt_ret, rc, rrc, round(rpt_gross-fact_net,2) diff FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.store_id=r.store_id ORDER BY abs(coalesce(rpt_gross,0)-coalesce(fact_net,0)) DESC LIMIT 12
